quello che.consejo: A relative compound of normal use.

chi vuole.consejo: Structure relative to verb in third person singular.

conoscere.consejo: Regular verb of the second conjugation.

texto: **Chi** without antecedent is equivalent to «who» or «the»: **Chi vuole, può venire** (anyone may come).
With verb in singular: **Chi sa** (who knows)
**Quello che** and **ciò che** mean «which»: **Quello che dici è vero** (what you say is true). **Ciò che conta** (which matters).

**Chiunque** means «quienquiera que» and usually goes with congiuntive: **Chiunque abbia un’idea può partecipare**. **Qualunque** accompanies a name: **qualunque libro**; in a subordinate, the congiuntive: **qualunque libro tu scelga** may also appear.

filas: Ciò che conta è il tempo.

frases.en: Whoever you want, you can come!

frases.it: Ciò che conta è il tempo.
frases.es: Lo que importa es el tiempo.
Cualquiera que tenga una idea puede participar.
frases.en: Anyone who has an idea can participate.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «Whoever wants, can come.»?

opciones.explicacion: «Chi» acts as a relative without antecedent with a third person verb.
«Quello» cannot act this way without «che».
Incorrectly mix third person with second of «potere».
«Ciò che» is formally equivalent to «which» and «contare» to have value or import.
It confuses the pronoun of «ciò che» things with «chi» person.
It mistranslates into the past what is present.
It equals «which» by introducing a substantive proposal.
It refers exclusively to animated beings («who»).
It is determinant («any») and needs substantive accompaniment.

opciones.texto: Anyone who has an idea can participate.
opciones.explicacion: «Chiunque» governs congiuntive imperfect or present as appropriate.

opciones.texto: Who had an idea could have been involved.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase is not found in past time.

opciones.texto: Someone has an idea and he's involved.
opciones.explicacion: It disrupts the universal and hypothetical nuance of «chiunque».

bloques.pregunta: What does Luca say to support Sara's comment?

opciones.explicacion: Structure with relative «quello che» and predictive adjective «vero».

opciones.texto: Tutto quello che pensi è falso.
opciones.explicacion: It inverts the sense by claiming falsehood.

opciones.texto: Quello che fai non serve a niente.
opciones.explicacion: It changes the verb and transmits a negative assessment.

bloques.explicacion: Order the phrase with the neutral formal relative.

bloques.frase: Chiunque ___ un'idea è benvenuto alla riunione.

opciones.explicacion: «Chiunque» rules the verb in subjunctive mode (present congiuntive).
The indicative mode is inappropriate after «chiunque».
A conjugated form is required and not a naked infinitive.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way for «what I want»?

opciones.explicacion: Relative substantial with «quello che».
«Chi» only refers to people.
«Ciò» requires the «che» conjunction to link to the verb.

intro: There are no antecedents: «Who wants to?», «what you say», «anyone you have». In Italian, **chi**, **quello che** and **chiunque** are used.
